parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding all other parts together.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the movable components like doors and drawers.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures it stands level on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides internal storage space for organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but can sometimes be adjustable or removable.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and conceals the contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment located at the top of the cabinet, made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a convenient space for storing smaller items that need frequent access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or runners for easy access.
